anchor.intro: {TIMECHECK} Welcome to GLC News. Ahead: Western leaders push for global A.I. controls, Spanish patrols lose ground to cocaine speedboats, Bentley unveils its first electric S.U.V., and England captain Harry Kane eyes the N.F.L. as a placekicker.
anchor.outro: Thanks Ernest for that report. That wraps this GLC News bulletin. Thank you for listening.

reporters.handoff: First, Edith with two stories, starting with that A.I. control push.

stories.topic: Western leaders push global AI controls
stories.script: A group of Western presidents and prime ministers is leading a new push for global controls on artificial intelligence, the Wall Street Journal reports. The effort is being framed like nuclear arms treaties from the Atomic Era, with leaders arguing that A.I. risks need coordinated limits rather than a patchwork of national rules. The Journal says the club is trying to set norms on safety, testing, and deployment before the technology races further ahead of regulation.

stories.topic: Spanish patrols losing fight to cocaine speedboats
stories.script: Spanish patrols are losing a battle against drug-smuggling speedboats that outrun authorities and deliver cocaine by the ton, according to the Wall Street Journal. One captain ordered a retreat, saying they are going to kill us, as faster boats and heavier loads overwhelm coastal enforcement. The Journal describes a cat-and-mouse fight where smugglers keep upgrading engines while patrol crews face deadly risk and limited options to stop them.

reporters.signoff: I am Edith, for GLC News.

reporters.handoff: Thanks Edith. Mark next, on Bentley's first electric S.U.V.

stories.topic: Bentley unveils Torcal first EV SUV
stories.script: Bentley has unveiled its first electric vehicle, the Torcal S.U.V., with a starting price of about two hundred eighteen thousand dollars. Reuters and Bentley say the Torcal is rated for roughly three hundred seventy-three miles of W.L.T.P. range on a one hundred thirteen kilowatt-hour battery, and can charge from ten to eighty percent in about sixteen minutes. The luxury brand is pitching the Torcal as the start of its shift away from combustion toward a full electric lineup.

reporters.signoff: I am Mark, for GLC News.

reporters.handoff: Thanks Mark. Ernest on Harry Kane and the N.F.L.

stories.topic: Harry Kane exploring NFL placekicker path
stories.script: England captain Harry Kane says he plans to seriously explore joining the N.F.L. as a placekicker after his soccer career, and that a move could sit alongside Major League Soccer. Coverage from E.S.P.N. and R.T.E. says Kane has not set a timeline, but he framed American football kicking as a real option once his club and international days wind down. For now he remains focused on Bayern Munich and England, while leaving the door open to a second act in the States.

reporters.signoff: I am Ernest, for GLC News.
